question: A company stores millions of objects larger than 1 MB in S3. Access frequency changes unpredictably. All objects must remain available with millisecond access, and the team wants automatic tier management. Which option best fits?

options.text: Move all objects to S3 Standard-IA solely because current-day access is low
options.explanation: Pola satu hari tidak cukup menentukan cocoknya IA untuk pola berubah; retrieval dan minimum charges dapat mengurangi penghematan.

options.text: Enable Intelligent-Tiering Archive Access and Deep Archive Access for every object
options.explanation: Optional archive tiers membutuhkan restore dan tidak sesuai dengan kebutuhan setiap objek selalu dapat diakses dalam milidetik.

options.text: Transition all objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after one day
options.explanation: Deep Archive tidak memberi retrieval langsung dan pola akses tidak diketahui.

options.text: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering without enabling its optional asynchronous archive-access tiers
options.explanation: Automatic tiers dapat menyesuaikan pola akses, sementara tidak mengaktifkan optional archive tiers mempertahankan jalur akses langsung yang diminta.

question: A company retains large compliance archives for seven years. Retrieval is extremely rare, and retrieval workflows can accommodate a delay of about two days. Among the listed classes, which offers the lowest storage-cost tier intended for this long-term archive pattern?

options.text: S3 Standard
options.explanation: Standard mempertahankan akses sering dengan latency rendah; fitur tersebut tidak diperlukan untuk arsip jarang diakses pada soal.

options.text: S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.explanation: Deep Archive ditujukan untuk retensi panjang dengan akses sangat jarang dan retrieval yang tidak harus instan.

options.text: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
options.explanation: Instant Retrieval sesuai jika objek arsip harus langsung dibaca, bukan tujuan biaya storage paling rendah dengan toleransi restore dua hari.

options.text: S3 Standard-IA
options.explanation: Standard-IA menyediakan akses langsung yang tidak diperlukan, sehingga bukan tier penyimpanan arsip terendah di antara opsi ini.

question: Objects are uploaded to S3, read frequently for ten days, and permanently deleted on day 20. An architect proposes moving them to Standard-IA on day 10 to save money. What should the architect recognize?

options.text: Standard-IA removes all minimum-duration and retrieval charges when lifecycle performs the transition
options.explanation: Lifecycle tidak menghapus ketentuan biaya kelas tujuan.

options.text: Moving the objects to Deep Archive on day 10 guarantees free retrieval and immediate deletion with no remaining charges
options.explanation: Deep Archive bukan retrieval gratis-instans dan memiliki ketentuan minimum penyimpanan yang lebih panjang.

options.text: Standard-IA transition eligibility and minimum-duration charges make this proposed short-lived lifecycle unsuitable; compare the full cost before changing classes
options.explanation: Transisi lifecycle ke Standard-IA memiliki batas usia objek dan kelas tersebut memiliki minimum storage duration; biaya tidak ditentukan oleh harga per-GB saja.

options.text: Any lower advertised storage rate guarantees a lower total cost even for objects deleted soon afterward
options.explanation: Minimum charges, transisi, dan retrieval dapat membuat total biaya lebih tinggi.

question: An application stores relatively little data, but its gp2 volume was enlarged mainly to obtain more IOPS. The required IOPS and throughput fit within gp3 limits. Which change can reduce unnecessary capacity provisioning?

options.text: Move the database files to an S3 Glacier class while keeping the same block-device interface
options.explanation: Glacier bukan pengganti block device aktif dengan latency I/O yang sama.

options.text: Evaluate gp3 with storage capacity, IOPS, and throughput configured to the measured requirements
options.explanation: gp3 memungkinkan konfigurasi performa terpisah dari kapasitas sehingga tidak perlu membeli kapasitas besar hanya untuk menaikkan baseline IOPS gp2.

options.text: Use an st1 volume and assume HDD random-I/O behavior is identical to SSD
options.explanation: Mengganti ke HDD tanpa melihat pola I/O dapat melanggar kebutuhan performa database.

options.text: Keep increasing gp2 capacity even though the application does not need additional storage
options.explanation: Ini mempertahankan pembelian kapasitas tidak terpakai yang ingin dikurangi.

question: An application uses a large EFS file system. Most files have not been accessed for months, but applications must keep using the same NFS paths. Occasional access to cold files is acceptable. Which option should the team evaluate to lower storage cost with limited code changes?

options.text: Move all files to S3 Deep Archive and expect existing NFS mounts to work unchanged
options.explanation: S3 tidak mempertahankan antarmuka EFS NFS hanya karena data dipindahkan.

options.text: Configure EFS Lifecycle management for appropriate infrequent-access or archive classes after evaluating access costs and latency
options.explanation: Lifecycle mempertahankan akses melalui file system sambil memindahkan file eligible berdasarkan policy; pola cold files sesuai untuk evaluasi ini.

options.text: Delete the mount targets but leave the file system intact
options.explanation: Menghilangkan mount targets dapat memutus akses tanpa menghapus biaya data yang tetap tersimpan.

options.text: Increase EFS throughput settings even though cold-file storage dominates the bill
options.explanation: Menambah throughput tidak menurunkan biaya penyimpanan file dingin.

question: A company finds storage charges for incomplete S3 multipart uploads from failed client sessions. Completed objects must not be deleted. Which actions address this waste? Select TWO.

options.text: Have clients explicitly abort multipart uploads that they intentionally abandon
options.explanation: Abort pada sisi client membersihkan parts ketika proses upload diputuskan tidak akan dilanjutkan.

options.text: Enable S3 Versioning and assume it automatically removes all uncommitted parts
options.explanation: Versioning bukan mekanisme cleanup incomplete multipart uploads.

options.text: Expire every completed object after one day regardless of retention requirements
options.explanation: Ini melanggar kebutuhan menjaga completed objects dan bukan cleanup yang ditargetkan.

options.text: Configure a lifecycle rule to abort incomplete multipart uploads after an appropriate number of days
options.explanation: Rule ini menargetkan parts dari upload yang belum selesai, bukan menghapus completed objects.

options.text: Transition incomplete parts to Deep Archive without aborting the upload
options.explanation: Lifecycle abort adalah mekanisme yang sesuai; mengarsipkan parts tidak menyelesaikan abandoned uploads.

question: A company expects a stable baseline of compute spending for the next year, but it may move workloads between EC2 instance families, AWS Fargate, and Lambda. Which purchase option best preserves that flexibility while discounting eligible baseline usage?

options.text: An EC2 Instance Savings Plan tied to one instance family and Region as the discount for all three services
options.explanation: EC2 Instance Savings Plans memiliki cakupan lebih spesifik dan bukan diskon untuk seluruh Fargate/Lambda seperti Compute Savings Plans.

options.text: An EC2 Capacity Reservation assumed to discount all Lambda invocations
options.explanation: Capacity Reservation bukan rencana diskon lintas ketiga layanan tersebut.

options.text: A Compute Savings Plan sized to the eligible hourly baseline
options.explanation: Compute Savings Plans memiliki fleksibilitas lintas penggunaan eligible EC2, Fargate, dan Lambda dengan komitmen pengeluaran per jam.

options.text: A Reserved DB Instance covering the application compute spend
options.explanation: Reserved DB pricing berlaku untuk penggunaan database yang cocok, bukan baseline EC2/Fargate/Lambda umum.

question: A batch workload consists of independent tasks that can checkpoint and restart. It has a flexible completion window and can use multiple compatible instance types. Which design is best suited to reducing EC2 purchase cost while accommodating interruptions?

options.text: Use a single fixed Spot capacity pool and assume it guarantees availability for the entire completion window
options.explanation: Satu pool tanpa fleksibilitas meningkatkan risiko kapasitas dan Spot bukan jaminan kapasitas.

options.text: Buy dedicated physical hosts solely because the workload is interruptible
options.explanation: Dedicated Hosts menjawab kebutuhan isolasi/licensing tertentu, bukan diskon yang berasal dari toleransi interupsi.

options.text: Use a diversified Spot fleet with checkpointing, retry logic, and an appropriate capacity-aware allocation strategy
options.explanation: Sifat tugas yang bisa dilanjutkan dan fleksibilitas tipe cocok dengan Spot; diversifikasi dan recovery mengurangi dampak interupsi.

options.text: Use Spot but disable retries because interrupted instances always finish their tasks first
options.explanation: Spot dapat terinterupsi; tidak ada jaminan job selesai sebelum interupsi.

question: A company buys a Compute Savings Plan and assumes it now has guaranteed EC2 capacity for a particular instance type in one Availability Zone. A launch later fails because capacity is unavailable. Which statement correctly separates the two requirements?

options.text: The Savings Plan discounts eligible usage; a suitable Capacity Reservation is a separate mechanism for reserving matching EC2 capacity
options.explanation: Komitmen diskon tidak sama dengan kapasitas AZ yang dicadangkan. Reservasi harus sesuai atribut dan ketentuan yang relevan.

options.text: Any Savings Plan automatically reserves every discounted instance type in every Availability Zone
options.explanation: Cakupan diskon tidak berarti kapasitas fisik otomatis tersedia di semua lokasi.

options.text: A Spot interruption notice can be used as a long-term capacity reservation
options.explanation: Notice interupsi bukan kontrak untuk menyediakan kapasitas yang diminta.

options.text: Purchasing a larger Savings Plan always resolves a capacity shortage
options.explanation: Menambah komitmen biaya tidak menambah kapasitas yang dicadangkan.

question: A development team uses EBS-backed EC2 instances only on weekdays during office hours. The instances have no required overnight processes, and their persistent volumes must be retained. Which actions appropriately reduce waste? Select TWO.

options.text: Terminate all instances without preserving the required data or a rebuild plan
options.explanation: Ini tidak memenuhi kebutuhan data dan kesiapan lingkungan development.

options.text: Account for continuing storage and other retained-resource charges while instances are stopped
options.explanation: Stopping tidak berarti seluruh resource terkait menjadi gratis; EBS dan resource lain tetap harus dihitung.

options.text: Leave every instance running and only reduce CloudWatch dashboard refresh frequency
options.explanation: Frekuensi dashboard tidak menghilangkan biaya compute idle utama.

options.text: Assume stopping an instance deletes all attached EBS volumes and their backups
options.explanation: Stop tidak sama dengan menghapus instance dan volume; asumsi ini salah untuk rencana retensi.

options.text: Automate stopping and starting the instances around the approved working schedule
options.explanation: Schedule mengurangi waktu compute berjalan saat tidak diperlukan sambil mempertahankan EBS yang perlu disimpan.

question: A lightweight event handler runs for a few seconds per request and is idle for most of the day. It fits Lambda runtime and resource limits, has no special hardware requirement, and does not need pre-initialized capacity. Which option avoids paying for an always-running worker?

options.text: Invoke Lambda on demand for each event, with retries and permissions configured for the event source
options.explanation: Model on-demand menghindari worker yang selalu berjalan untuk pola yang sebagian besar idle, selama batas dan semantics event dipenuhi.

options.text: Configure substantial Lambda provisioned concurrency for the entire day despite no initialization-latency requirement
options.explanation: Provisioned concurrency menambah kapasitas berbayar yang tidak diperlukan berdasarkan kebutuhan soal.

options.text: Run the handler in an always-on dedicated host solely to avoid per-request charges
options.explanation: Dedicated host selalu aktif tidak sesuai tujuan menghindari biaya idle untuk fungsi ringan.

options.text: Keep a large EC2 worker running continuously even when no events arrive
options.explanation: Ini mempertahankan idle compute yang menjadi sasaran pengurangan.

question: A cost review finds low average EC2 CPU utilization, but the application has brief memory-heavy peaks and a strict latency objective. Which approach is most appropriate before downsizing?

options.text: Buy a three-year commitment for a smaller type before running any validation
options.explanation: Komitmen lebih awal dapat mengunci keputusan yang melanggar kebutuhan performa.

options.text: Remove monitoring to lower cost before establishing whether the smaller size works
options.explanation: Menghilangkan observabilitas mengurangi kemampuan memvalidasi perubahan dan risiko.

options.text: Review representative CPU, memory, and latency data, evaluate Compute Optimizer recommendations, and load-test the proposed size
options.explanation: Rightsizing perlu mempertimbangkan peak dan metrik selain rata-rata CPU. Rekomendasi menjadi input yang diuji, bukan keputusan otomatis.

options.text: Choose the smallest available instance solely from average CPU utilization
options.explanation: CPU rata-rata mengabaikan kebutuhan RAM dan peak yang dapat menyebabkan kegagalan atau latency tinggi.

question: A DynamoDB table has a measured, steady request rate with predictable modest growth. A cost model using current regional prices shows correctly sized provisioned capacity is cheaper than on-demand for this workload. Which approach best follows the evidence while handling growth?

options.text: Keep on-demand solely because it must always be cheaper regardless of utilization
options.explanation: Tidak ada model yang selalu termurah; soal memberikan hasil perhitungan workload ini.

options.text: Provision far below the sustained request rate and disable throttling alarms
options.explanation: Pengurangan biaya yang mengorbankan kebutuhan throughput bukan solusi yang memenuhi workload.

options.text: Provision for a hypothetical hundredfold peak indefinitely without checking demand
options.explanation: Overprovisioning besar bertentangan dengan data steady load dan tujuan cost optimization.

options.text: Use provisioned capacity sized for the workload, with suitable auto scaling, alarms, and periodic review
options.explanation: Hasil model dan pola stabil mendukung provisioned; auto scaling dan monitoring membantu mengelola perubahan tanpa menganggap sizing awal selalu benar.

question: A new DynamoDB application has unpredictable traffic and no reliable baseline for capacity planning. The team wants request-based billing and minimal management of read/write capacity. Which mode should it evaluate first?

options.text: Provisioned mode with a fixed small capacity and no monitoring or scaling
options.explanation: Beban tak terduga dapat melebihi kapasitas kecil dan menyebabkan throttling.

options.text: On-demand capacity mode, while still monitoring quotas, partition-key distribution, and any configured throughput limits
options.explanation: On-demand mengurangi kebutuhan provisioning manual dengan request-based billing, tetapi batas layanan dan hot keys tetap relevan.

options.text: On-demand mode with the assumption that it eliminates all throttling and quota constraints
options.explanation: Mode on-demand tidak menghapus seluruh limits atau masalah distribusi key.

options.text: A fixed provisioned allocation equal to the largest imaginable traffic spike for every hour
options.explanation: Ini membeli kapasitas idle berdasarkan hipotesis yang tidak tervalidasi.

question: A compatible Aurora PostgreSQL application has highly variable demand and long low-usage periods. The team wants database compute to scale within a configured range without repeatedly changing fixed instance classes. Which option should it evaluate?

options.text: A read replica used as the only autoscaling control for write capacity
options.explanation: Replica baca tidak otomatis menskalakan kapasitas writer untuk workload write.

options.text: An oversized fixed provisioned writer kept at peak capacity at all times
options.explanation: Model ini tidak menyesuaikan compute secara elastis sesuai pola yang diminta.

options.text: RDS Proxy alone, because pooling automatically changes the database instance size
options.explanation: Proxy mengelola koneksi; tidak menjadi mekanisme autoscaling compute database sendiri.

options.text: Aurora Serverless capacity with suitable minimum and maximum settings and a workload cost test
options.explanation: Aurora Serverless menyesuaikan kapasitas compute terhadap kebutuhan dalam batas yang dikonfigurasi; uji biaya dan performa tetap diperlukan.

question: A production RDS database will run continuously for the next year. Its engine, Region, and eligible instance configuration are expected to remain stable. Which action can discount matching database instance usage without migrating the database?

options.text: Create an additional standby solely because a second instance always reduces the total bill
options.explanation: Tambahan kapasitas/availability tidak otomatis mengurangi total biaya.

options.text: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan and assume it covers ordinary RDS DB instance charges
options.explanation: Compute Savings Plans bukan diskon untuk ordinary RDS DB instance usage yang ditanyakan.

options.text: Stop the production database nightly even though it must operate continuously
options.explanation: Ini melanggar kebutuhan availability operasional 24 jam.

options.text: Purchase an appropriately matched Reserved DB Instance offering after reviewing its term and payment options
options.explanation: Reserved DB Instance adalah mekanisme billing discount untuk penggunaan yang memenuhi atribut/ketentuan, bukan migrasi data ke mesin terpisah.

question: A DynamoDB table stores temporary session records. The company wants old records cleaned up with minimal custom deletion code, but sessions must become invalid at their exact expiration time. Which design satisfies both requirements?

options.text: Enable TTL for cleanup and have the application independently reject sessions whose expiration timestamp has passed
options.explanation: TTL menghapus item expired secara asinkron. Aplikasi harus menegakkan expiry tepat waktu, bukan menunggu penghapusan fisik.

options.text: Enable TTL and keep accepting a session until the item disappears
options.explanation: Item expired dapat tetap ada beberapa waktu, sehingga akses dapat diterima melewati expiry.

options.text: Remove expiration timestamps and periodically delete random records to keep the table small
options.explanation: Penghapusan acak tidak mempertahankan semantics session atau batas expiry.

options.text: Disable the application expiration check because TTL deletion is guaranteed at the exact second
options.explanation: Tidak ada jaminan penghapusan TTL tepat pada detik expiry.

question: A company has many manual RDS snapshots from retired test environments. Some are still required by policy, but others exceed the approved retention period. Which actions reduce waste without undermining recovery requirements? Select TWO.

options.text: Assume retained snapshots become free as soon as the source DB instance is deleted
options.explanation: Storage backup yang tetap disimpan tidak otomatis menjadi gratis hanya karena source dihapus.

options.text: Delete every snapshot regardless of policy because the source database no longer runs
options.explanation: Database berhenti tidak berarti semua snapshot tidak dibutuhkan.

options.text: Remove snapshots that are confirmed unnecessary and automate future retention review or lifecycle where supported
options.explanation: Cleanup ditargetkan pada data yang sudah tidak diperlukan, lalu proses dibuat berulang agar pemborosan tidak kembali.

options.text: Disable all production backups to offset charges from unused test snapshots
options.explanation: Ini memindahkan risiko ke production, bukan memperbaiki sumber pemborosan yang diidentifikasi.

options.text: Inventory snapshot ownership and retention requirements before identifying deletable snapshots
options.explanation: Ownership dan kebutuhan recovery menentukan snapshot mana yang aman dihapus.

source.title: RDS snapshot deletion and retention charges

question: EC2 workers in private subnets transfer a large amount of data to S3 in the same Region through a NAT gateway. They require no special cross-network S3 access. Which change can remove NAT processing charges for this S3 traffic?

options.text: Increase the NAT gateway's traffic volume so its per-GB processing becomes automatically free
options.explanation: Volume lebih besar tidak otomatis membuat processing charges NAT hilang.

options.text: Keep the NAT route and enable S3 Versioning
options.explanation: Versioning tidak mengubah jalur jaringan ke S3.

options.text: Create an S3 gateway endpoint and associate the appropriate subnet route tables
options.explanation: Gateway endpoint mengarahkan traffic S3 yang cocok tanpa NAT dan tidak mengenakan endpoint hourly/processing charges seperti yang dijelaskan dalam pricing AWS.

options.text: Add an interface endpoint solely on the assumption that all endpoint types have identical zero processing cost
options.explanation: Interface dan gateway endpoint memiliki model biaya serta kemampuan berbeda; asumsi semua endpoint gratis tidak benar.

question: A production VPC must keep its existing zonal NAT gateway architecture. It has one NAT gateway in each of two Availability Zones, but every private subnet currently routes internet egress through the gateway in the first AZ. Which change reduces unnecessary cross-AZ traffic while preserving the two-AZ design?

options.text: Route each private subnet to the existing NAT gateway in its own Availability Zone
options.explanation: Pada desain zonal, memakai gateway lokal menghindari traversal lintas AZ yang tidak perlu dan mengurangi ketergantungan jalur egress pada AZ pertama.

options.text: Replace all default routes with S3 gateway endpoint routes for arbitrary internet destinations
options.explanation: Gateway endpoint S3 bukan jalur untuk seluruh tujuan internet.

options.text: Delete the second NAT gateway and keep both AZs dependent on the first
options.explanation: Ini mengubah availability dependency dan bukan mempertahankan desain dua-AZ yang diberikan.

options.text: Route both private subnets through the gateway in a third AZ
options.explanation: Ini masih membuat traversal lintas AZ dan menambah ketergantungan.

question: Only two VPCs with non-overlapping CIDRs need direct private connectivity in one Region. There is no requirement for transitive routing, centralized inspection, or near-term expansion. Which design should be evaluated as a simpler alternative to Transit Gateway attachment and processing charges?

options.text: A direct VPC peering connection with the required routes and security rules
options.explanation: Untuk dua VPC langsung tanpa transit, peering menghindari komponen TGW yang tidak dibutuhkan; transfer charges yang berlaku tetap harus dihitung.

options.text: A public internet path with no encryption or access controls because it has fewer route tables
options.explanation: Mengurangi komponen tidak membenarkan menghilangkan kebutuhan private connectivity.

options.text: A Transit Gateway deployed solely because every VPC connection requires transitive routing
options.explanation: Soal secara eksplisit tidak memerlukan transit; kebutuhan tidak boleh ditambah tanpa alasan.

options.text: Two NAT gateways used as bidirectional private routers between the VPC CIDRs
options.explanation: NAT bukan pengganti peering private connectivity dua arah untuk kasus ini.

question: A global website repeatedly serves identical versioned assets from an EC2 origin. The company wants to reduce repeated origin requests and origin compute load. Which change directly supports this goal?

options.text: Use Global Accelerator and assume it caches every asset at the edge
options.explanation: Global Accelerator memperbaiki jalur jaringan yang sesuai, bukan CDN cache untuk objek.

options.text: Configure the caching-disabled policy for every immutable asset.
options.explanation: Mematikan caching tidak mengurangi repeated origin fetch; aset identik justru cocok dievaluasi untuk caching.

options.text: Add more origin instances but force every user request to bypass all caches
options.explanation: Ini dapat meningkatkan kapasitas tetapi tidak mengurangi repeat origin work.

options.text: Cache the assets in CloudFront with suitable TTLs and cache policies, then measure total delivery cost
options.explanation: Cache hits mengurangi fetch dan kerja origin. Biaya CloudFront serta pola akses tetap harus dimasukkan ke perhitungan total.

question: Several low-traffic HTTP services each use a separate ALB. They may share a frontend, their combined load fits the planned ALB capacity, and there is no separate-isolation requirement. Which design can reduce duplicated load-balancer resources?

options.text: Replace the ALBs with one NLB and expect native HTTP path-based rules
options.explanation: NLB tidak menyediakan routing layer-7 path seperti ALB.

options.text: Create an additional ALB for every URL path to minimize fixed components
options.explanation: Ini menambah duplikasi resource, berlawanan dengan tujuan soal.

options.text: Use one ALB with host- or path-based rules and separate target groups for the services
options.explanation: ALB mendukung routing beberapa layanan; berbagi frontend dapat mengurangi resource per-load-balancer yang diduplikasi ketika batas isolasi memungkinkan.

options.text: Place all services into one target group and remove any way to distinguish their host/path requirements
options.explanation: Penggabungan tidak boleh menghilangkan routing ke service yang benar.

question: A CloudFront distribution serves identical public images to all users. Its cache policy includes every cookie and query parameter, even though only an image-version parameter changes the image. Which actions improve cache reuse without changing the intended response? Select TWO.

options.text: Reuse the same policy for personalized invoice responses without checking authorization or response variation
options.explanation: Aturan untuk public identical assets tidak otomatis aman untuk data personal.

options.text: Exclude irrelevant cookies from the cache key for this public-image behavior
options.explanation: Cookie yang tidak mengubah respons memecah key tanpa manfaat; menghilangkannya meningkatkan peluang cache hit.

options.text: Exclude every parameter, including the version that changes the image
options.explanation: Ini dapat menyatukan respons berbeda dan mengirim versi gambar salah.

options.text: Set the TTL to zero for all image responses to increase cache hits
options.explanation: TTL nol mengurangi kegunaan cache reuse, bukan meningkatkan cache hits.

options.text: Include the image-version parameter but exclude query parameters that do not affect the response
options.explanation: Key tetap membedakan versi yang benar sambil menghindari fragmentasi dari parameter tak relevan.

question: An analyst runs Athena queries over years of uncompressed CSV logs but usually selects one day and a few fields. Which storage-layout change is most likely to reduce query scan charges while preserving the dataset?

options.text: Keep the CSV layout and increase S3 Versioning retention
options.explanation: Retention versi tidak mengurangi byte yang perlu dibaca query.

options.text: Convert to a suitable compressed columnar format, partition by date, and query with partition predicates
options.explanation: Kombinasi ini memungkinkan pembacaan kolom dan partisi relevan, bukan seluruh histori CSV.

options.text: Move all files into Deep Archive and assume Athena restores them transparently for instant queries
options.explanation: Archived objects membutuhkan restore dan bukan solusi instant query yang diasumsikan opsi ini.

options.text: Merge the entire history into one unpartitioned file and continue SELECT *
options.explanation: Ini mengurangi kemampuan membatasi scan pada tanggal dan kolom yang relevan.

question: A company stores derived thumbnails that can be regenerated from durable source images. They are accessed infrequently but need millisecond reads when requested. The company explicitly accepts losing the derived copy if one Availability Zone is destroyed. Which class should it evaluate for lower-cost storage of the derived copies?

options.text: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval as an always-online millisecond-access class
options.explanation: Flexible Retrieval memerlukan restore untuk akses dan tidak memenuhi pola immediate reads.

options.text: S3 One Zone-IA
options.explanation: One Zone-IA menyediakan akses langsung dengan penyimpanan dalam satu AZ; risiko tersebut sesuai hanya karena derived copies dapat dibuat ulang dan loss diterima.

options.text: S3 Standard solely because every reproducible object requires multi-AZ storage
options.explanation: Multi-AZ dapat tepat pada banyak kasus, tetapi soal menerima risiko satu AZ untuk salinan yang dapat dibuat ulang.

options.text: S3 Glacier Deep Archive without a restore process
options.explanation: Tidak memenuhi kebutuhan millisecond access saat thumbnail diminta.

question: A team keeps daily EBS snapshots. Older snapshots exceed the approved retention policy, but the team fears that deleting any older snapshot will break every newer incremental snapshot. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Snapshot deletion also deletes the live source EBS volume
options.explanation: Menghapus snapshot bukan menghapus volume live sumber.

options.text: Deleting any snapshot immediately frees the full provisioned size of its source volume
options.explanation: Biaya snapshot berdasarkan data tersimpan/referensi, bukan otomatis seluruh provisioned volume size.

options.text: EBS preserves blocks required by retained snapshots; deleting an old snapshot does not make a retained snapshot unrestorable, but savings depend on blocks no longer referenced
options.explanation: AWS mengelola referensi data antar snapshot. Hanya blocks yang tidak dibutuhkan snapshot lain yang dibebaskan sehingga savings tidak selalu sebesar ukuran volume.

options.text: Users must always retain the first snapshot forever or all later snapshots become unusable
options.explanation: Pengguna tidak perlu mempertahankan snapshot pertama selamanya agar snapshot retained dapat direstore.

question: A small office needs encrypted connectivity to a VPC for modest traffic. Existing internet connectivity is adequate, variable internet latency is acceptable, and there is no requirement for a dedicated circuit. Which option should be evaluated first for a lower fixed-infrastructure footprint?

options.text: A single public unencrypted application endpoint in place of the required encrypted network connection
options.explanation: Ini tidak memenuhi kebutuhan koneksi jaringan terenkripsi yang dinyatakan.

options.text: A dedicated Direct Connect circuit solely because all encrypted hybrid connections require one
options.explanation: Enkripsi hybrid tidak mensyaratkan Direct Connect; dedicated connectivity adalah kebutuhan terpisah.

options.text: Multiple dedicated circuits before measuring bandwidth or availability requirements
options.explanation: Menambah circuit tanpa kebutuhan terukur dapat menciptakan biaya tetap yang tidak relevan.

options.text: AWS Site-to-Site VPN using the existing internet connection and properly configured tunnels
options.explanation: VPN memenuhi kebutuhan enkripsi dan konektivitas dengan memanfaatkan internet yang sudah tersedia; dedicated circuit tidak diwajibkan.

question: A dataset is produced and stored in Region A. A daily process in Region B downloads the entire dataset only to produce a small summary used in B. There is no requirement to keep the compute in B, and regional processing services are equivalent. Which redesign reduces unnecessary inter-Region data transfer?

options.text: Keep downloading the entire dataset but increase DNS TTL
options.explanation: TTL DNS tidak mengurangi ukuran payload data yang ditransfer.

options.text: Use a NAT gateway for the same transfer and assume it eliminates inter-Region charges
options.explanation: NAT tidak menghapus charges transfer lintas Region dan dapat menambah processing charges.

options.text: Process the raw dataset in Region A and transfer only the required summary to Region B
options.explanation: Memindahkan komputasi ke dekat sumber menghindari transfer seluruh raw dataset ketika hasil yang dibutuhkan jauh lebih kecil.

options.text: Replicate the raw dataset twice to Region B before processing it
options.explanation: Duplikasi transfer memperbesar byte lintas Region tanpa memenuhi kebutuhan tambahan.

question: For a design exercise, assume a NAT-based path costs $0.05 per GB plus $30 per month, while an eligible gateway-endpoint path has no endpoint hourly or processing charge. The workload transfers 1,000 GB per month to S3 in the same Region and has no other internet traffic. If the now-unused NAT gateway can be removed, what monthly path-specific charge is avoided? Ignore all other costs and use these hypothetical rates.

options.explanation: Biaya yang dihindari = 1.000 x $0,05 + $30 = $80. Ini hanya model hipotetis dan asumsi NAT benar-benar dapat dihapus.
Ini hanya menghitung komponen per-GB dan melewatkan $30 biaya bulanan yang juga dihindari karena NAT dihapus.
Tidak ada komponen tambahan $50 pada model yang diberikan; jumlah tersebut menghitung biaya terlalu besar.
Ini hanya menghitung komponen bulanan dan mengabaikan processing 1.000 GB.

question: A research institution shares a large S3 dataset with authenticated organizations. Each organization should pay its own download and request charges, while the institution continues paying storage charges. Which option fits?

options.text: Use a bucket policy that grants GetObject and assume that permission alone changes billing.
options.explanation: Izin akses dan penetapan pihak pembayar adalah pengaturan berbeda.

options.text: Make the bucket public and rely on anonymous access to identify the payer.
options.explanation: Requester Pays tidak mendukung request anonim; bucket publik tidak otomatis mengalihkan biaya.

options.text: Enable S3 Requester Pays and require clients to acknowledge requester charges.
options.explanation: Requester Pays mengalihkan biaya request dan download ke requester yang terautentikasi; storage tetap dibayar pemilik.

options.text: Enable versioning and assume the latest reader pays all bucket storage.
options.explanation: Versioning tidak mengubah pemilik biaya penyimpanan.

question: EC2 resources are tagged with Department, but the team cannot group billing reports by that user-defined tag. What should be checked before changing instance sizes?

options.text: Whether the tag value is an EC2 instance type name rather than a department.
options.explanation: Nilai tag tidak harus memakai nama tipe instance.

options.text: Whether the Department tag is used only in an IAM authorization condition without cost-allocation activation.
options.explanation: Tag IAM dapat mengatur akses tetapi tidak otomatis aktif sebagai cost-allocation tag.

options.text: Whether Department has been activated as a cost allocation tag in Billing and Cost Management.
options.explanation: Tag pada resource perlu diaktifkan sebagai cost allocation tag agar tersedia untuk alokasi biaya.

options.text: Whether the report groups only by linked account instead of the activated Department dimension.
options.explanation: Grouping harus menggunakan dimensi yang diminta; account saja tidak memisahkan departemen dalam akun yang sama.

question: A sandbox needs warnings when actual or forecast monthly spend exceeds a threshold. The owner proposes an AWS Budget and assumes no further charges can occur after the threshold. Which assessment is correct?

options.text: A cost budget automatically stops every AWS resource at the exact threshold without configuration.
options.explanation: Budget bukan pemutus universal realtime untuk semua biaya.

options.text: Only EC2 utilization alarms can provide cost-threshold notifications, so a monetary budget cannot be used.
options.explanation: Metrik utilization bukan satu-satunya mekanisme; AWS Budgets mendukung threshold biaya.

options.text: Cost alerts require removing all IAM permissions from the account owner first.
options.explanation: Notifikasi tidak memerlukan penghapusan seluruh akses pemilik.

options.text: Budgets can notify and support configured actions, but billing updates and actions are not an instantaneous universal spending cap.
options.explanation: Biaya diperbarui berkala; kontrol tambahan dan tindakan terencana diperlukan untuk membatasi penggunaan.

question: A platform team needs repeatable SQL analysis of usage line items, accounts, and activated cost tags over billing history. It wants the underlying data in its own S3 bucket. Which approach fits?

options.text: Export detailed cost-and-usage data to S3 and query it with Athena using the appropriate schema.
options.explanation: Data biaya terperinci memungkinkan analisis SQL berulang; pastikan format export dan schema sesuai.

options.text: Use only an AWS Pricing Calculator estimate as the actual historical usage ledger.
options.explanation: Estimate konfigurasi bukan catatan pemakaian aktual.

options.text: Use only CloudTrail management events as a complete invoice replacement.
options.explanation: Log API tidak memuat seluruh perhitungan biaya dan line item billing.

options.text: Use only a monthly budget notification email as a queryable resource-level dataset.
options.explanation: Notifikasi agregat bukan dataset detail untuk analisis SQL.

question: A general purpose S3 bucket stores millions of objects encrypted with SSE-KMS. KMS request charges are significant. The application can accept the documented encryption-context and audit differences. Which feature should be evaluated?

options.text: Enable S3 versioning as the mechanism that caches KMS data keys.
options.explanation: Versioning tidak menyediakan optimasi request KMS yang dimaksud.

options.text: Switch to DSSE-KMS and assume S3 Bucket Keys support that mode.
options.explanation: Bucket Keys tidak didukung untuk DSSE-KMS dalam dokumentasi yang diperiksa.

options.text: Disable all encryption because reducing KMS requests requires plaintext objects.
options.explanation: Bucket Keys tidak mengharuskan penghapusan enkripsi.

options.text: S3 Bucket Keys for supported SSE-KMS objects.
options.explanation: Bucket Keys mengurangi traffic request ke KMS sambil tetap memakai SSE-KMS; objek lama perlu penanganan tersendiri.

question: A versioned bucket overwrites reports daily. Only the latest report and 30 days of prior versions are required, but old versions accumulate. Which lifecycle change addresses the unnecessary storage?

options.text: Configure noncurrent-version expiration consistent with the 30-day recovery requirement.
options.explanation: Aturan noncurrent mengatur versi lama tanpa menganggap penghapusan current object membersihkan seluruh history.

options.text: Expire only current objects and assume all noncurrent versions are immediately removed.
options.explanation: Delete marker dan versi noncurrent dapat tetap tersimpan.

options.text: Disable access logging and leave every noncurrent version untouched.
options.explanation: Ini tidak menyasar storage versi lama yang menjadi masalah.

options.text: Add replication to another Region as the primary way to remove old versions.
options.explanation: Replikasi menambah salinan dan tidak menggantikan lifecycle history.

question: A workload creates millions of tiny log objects. A proposal compares archive tiers using only the advertised per-GB storage rate. Which additional factors should be included before deciding whether to compact and archive the logs? Select TWO.

options.text: Only the number of IAM users that can view the bucket console.
options.explanation: Jumlah pengguna bukan faktor utama biaya object/request dalam skenario ini.

options.text: Assume every archive tier provides instant access without retrieval charges.
options.explanation: Karakter restore, minimum durasi, dan biaya berbeda antar kelas.

options.text: Assume compaction is always correct even if individual records must be deleted independently.
options.explanation: Kebutuhan retensi dan penghapusan dapat membuat penggabungan tidak sesuai.

options.text: Per-object/request charges, minimum billable sizes or durations where applicable, and retrieval patterns.
options.explanation: Biaya tidak hanya per GB; objek kecil dan umur singkat dapat mengubah hasil total.

options.text: Whether compaction still permits the required lookup, retention, and deletion behavior.
options.explanation: Penggabungan objek dapat mengurangi overhead tetapi mengubah granularitas akses dan penghapusan.

question: An EC2 log-processing job needs a non-boot block volume for large sequential scans. Its measured throughput fits st1 limits and it does not need low-latency small random I/O. Which option deserves a cost comparison first?

options.text: Provisioned IOPS SSD solely because all block workloads need maximum random IOPS.
options.explanation: Kebutuhan adalah throughput sequential, bukan IOPS random maksimum.

options.text: S3 Glacier Deep Archive mounted as an EBS volume without restore.
options.explanation: Object archive bukan perangkat block EBS siap pakai.

options.text: Throughput Optimized HDD (st1), sized and benchmarked for the required throughput.
options.explanation: st1 ditujukan untuk I/O besar berurutan; batas volume dan instance tetap diperiksa.

options.text: An st1 volume used as the EC2 boot volume.
options.explanation: st1 tidak mendukung boot volume.

question: For the same workload, a Lambda benchmark takes 2 seconds at 1 GB and 0.8 seconds at 2 GB. Assume identical per-GB-second rates, request counts, and other charges; both satisfy latency requirements. Which configuration uses less billed compute?

options.text: 2 GB, because 2 x 0.8 = 1.6 GB-seconds instead of 2 GB-seconds.
options.explanation: Perhitungan memakai alokasi dikali durasi; konfigurasi memori lebih besar dapat lebih murah per pekerjaan.

options.text: Both settings have equal compute cost because each uses a different amount of memory.
options.explanation: Bandingkan memory dikali duration yang diberikan; jumlah memory berbeda saja tidak membuktikan biaya sama.

options.text: 1 GB, because a smaller memory setting always costs less regardless of duration.
options.explanation: Durasi 2 detik membuat compute 2 GB-detik, lebih besar dari 1,6.

options.text: 2 GB, because its billed compute is 0.8 GB-seconds rather than 2 GB-seconds.
options.explanation: Duration 0.8 detik harus dikalikan memory 2 GB; hasilnya 1.6 GB-seconds, bukan 0.8.

question: An ECS batch service processes durable queued jobs. Jobs checkpoint to S3, retries are idempotent, and completion can be delayed during spare-capacity shortages. Which capacity option can lower compute cost without making a fixed-capacity promise?

options.text: Disable checkpoint writes so interrupted tasks are guaranteed to resume from memory.
options.explanation: Memori task yang berhenti bukan checkpoint durabel.

options.text: Fargate Spot for every noncheckpointed critical request with no retry design.
options.explanation: Kondisi toleransi pada batch tidak berlaku otomatis untuk semua request kritis.

options.text: Fargate Spot for suitable tasks, with interruption handling and a fallback policy if deadlines require it.
options.explanation: Spot cocok untuk pekerjaan toleran interupsi; kapasitas tidak dijamin selalu tersedia.

options.text: A Compute Savings Plan as a reservation guaranteeing immediate Fargate Spot capacity.
options.explanation: Diskon komitmen bukan jaminan kapasitas Spot.

question: A Linux service is mostly portable code but includes native libraries. The team considers Graviton-based instances to improve price-performance. What is the best next step?

options.text: Commit the entire peak spend before testing libraries or demand.
options.explanation: Komitmen tanpa bukti kompatibilitas dan utilisasi berisiko pemborosan.

options.text: Build a compatible Arm artifact and benchmark correctness, throughput, latency, and cost per unit of work.
options.explanation: Kompatibilitas native dependency dan hasil workload menentukan manfaat, bukan label prosesor saja.

options.text: Launch the existing x86-only binary on Arm and assume automatic instruction compatibility.
options.explanation: Arsitektur binary perlu kompatibel dengan hardware tujuan.

options.text: Compare hourly prices only while ignoring that throughput may differ.
options.explanation: Harga per jam tidak menunjukkan biaya per transaksi yang berhasil.

question: Eligible compute spend has a stable baseline and a much larger peak for two hours weekly. The company wants a long-term commitment discount without paying for a mostly unused commitment. Which strategy is appropriate?

options.text: Evaluate a commitment around dependable baseline usage and cover uncertain peaks with flexible capacity.
options.explanation: Komitmen harus dinilai terhadap penggunaan yang konsisten, bukan puncak yang jarang terjadi.

options.text: Assume unused hourly commitment can always be banked indefinitely for next week.
options.explanation: Komitmen per jam bukan tabungan kapasitas lintas waktu yang tak terbatas.

options.text: Remove all monitoring once the commitment is purchased.
options.explanation: Utilisasi dan perubahan workload tetap perlu dipantau.

options.text: Commit to the weekly maximum for every hour of the term.
options.explanation: Jam sepi tetap menanggung komitmen yang tidak termanfaatkan.

question: A development web service is used on weekdays only. It can tolerate startup delay, its persistent data is external, and the environment is reproducible. What can reduce idle compute cost?

options.text: Delete the persistent database every evening regardless of retention requirements.
options.explanation: Tujuannya mengurangi compute idle tanpa kehilangan data.

options.text: Keep the fleet at its measured peak count and reduce only its storage allocation.
options.explanation: Pemborosan compute saat idle tetap ada; perubahan storage tidak mengurangi jam instance.

options.text: Purchase maximum long-term capacity before testing the weekday schedule.
options.explanation: Komitmen maksimum dapat mengunci biaya yang seharusnya dihilangkan.

options.text: Schedule the disposable service capacity to zero outside working hours and restore it before use.
options.explanation: Mematikan kapasitas idle mengurangi compute; data eksternal dan automation memungkinkan pemulihan.

question: A DynamoDB catalog display can tolerate short propagation delays. It currently uses strongly consistent base-table reads for every display request. Which change can reduce read-unit consumption without changing the stated user experience?

options.text: Use eventual reads for balance settlement too, without checking correctness requirements.
options.explanation: Toleransi katalog tidak berlaku otomatis untuk operasi finansial.

options.text: Use eventually consistent reads for this display path while retaining stronger reads where required elsewhere.
options.explanation: Eventual read mengonsumsi lebih sedikit read unit untuk ukuran data yang sama; hanya dipakai pada jalur yang menerima stale data.

options.text: Add a filter expression and assume filtered-out items consume no read capacity.
options.explanation: Filter diterapkan setelah data dibaca dan bukan cara menghapus konsumsi tersebut.

options.text: Enable a strongly consistent GSI read as the cheaper alternative.
options.explanation: GSI tidak mendukung strong read.

question: A DynamoDB query reads many items and discards nearly all of them with a filter expression. Read costs remain high. Which redesign can reduce the amount actually read for a frequent access pattern?

options.text: Use an appropriate key/index access pattern that narrows the items selected before filtering.
options.explanation: Key condition dan indeks yang tepat mengurangi data yang dibaca, bukan hanya hasil yang dikembalikan.

options.text: Keep the same scan and add a client-side filter after the response arrives.
options.explanation: Filter client tidak mengurangi data yang sudah dibaca DynamoDB.

options.text: Add more filter predicates and assume capacity is charged only for final output.
options.explanation: Konsumsi read dihitung sebelum filter hasil.

options.text: Increase the response page size so all discarded items are always read together.
options.explanation: Membaca lebih banyak kandidat tidak menyelesaikan biaya seleksi buruk.

question: A DynamoDB table has several GSIs projecting every attribute. Some indexes are unused, and frequently changed large attributes are not needed by the remaining index queries. Which actions should be evaluated? Select TWO.

options.text: Replace all key queries with full table scans without measuring.
options.explanation: Scan dapat meningkatkan biaya baca dan latency.

options.text: Add every table attribute to additional duplicate indexes.
options.explanation: Ini meningkatkan storage dan pemeliharaan indeks.

options.text: Assume GSI updates never consume write resources.
options.explanation: Write ke indeks turut memengaruhi biaya dan kapasitas.

options.text: Remove indexes confirmed unnecessary for application access patterns.
options.explanation: Indeks tidak terpakai dapat menambah biaya tanpa manfaat; pastikan tidak ada consumer tersembunyi.

options.text: Limit projections to the attributes needed by remaining index access patterns.
options.explanation: Proyeksi tepat dapat mengurangi storage dan write yang terkait perubahan atribut.

question: For a supported Aurora deployment, a forecast estimates Standard at $800 for compute/storage plus $500 for I/O. The equivalent I/O-Optimized configuration is estimated at $1,100 total with no separate read/write I/O charge. Other costs are equal. Which is less expensive in this forecast?

options.text: Standard, because $800 is lower than $1,100 regardless of I/O charges.
options.explanation: Biaya I/O 500 harus dimasukkan dalam total Standard.

options.text: Both always cost the same because storage modes only change availability.
options.explanation: Mode biaya I/O dan total perkiraan berbeda.

options.text: I/O-Optimized by $500 because its compute and storage charges must be ignored.
options.explanation: Penghematan dibandingkan total lengkap, bukan menghapus komponen biaya lainnya.

options.text: I/O-Optimized, by $200 per month.
options.explanation: Standard berjumlah 1.300; I/O-Optimized 1.100, sehingga selisihnya 200 dengan asumsi soal.

question: An RDS DB instance grew substantially during a one-time import. Data is later removed, but allocated storage and charges do not shrink. What should the cost plan recognize?

options.text: Switch to Multi-AZ and assume it halves primary storage allocation.
options.explanation: HA tidak mengubah kebutuhan alokasi dengan cara tersebut.

options.text: RDS storage autoscaling increases allocated storage; reducing allocation requires a supported migration/recreation approach, not automatic shrink.
options.explanation: Menghapus row tidak otomatis mengecilkan alokasi; rencanakan strategi pemindahan jika pengurangan layak.

options.text: Delete every automated backup to force the primary volume to shrink.
options.explanation: Backup terpisah dari alokasi storage instance utama.

options.text: Disable autoscaling and expect existing allocated storage to shrink immediately.
options.explanation: Menonaktifkan fitur tidak mengurangi alokasi yang sudah ada.

question: A NAT gateway must remain for unrelated traffic. For one AWS service, assume an interface endpoint costs $20 monthly plus $0.01/GB. Sending that service traffic through the existing NAT adds $0.045/GB. Ignore all other differences. At 1,000 GB monthly, which path has lower incremental cost?

options.text: The endpoint saves the entire NAT monthly bill even though NAT must remain.
options.explanation: Biaya tetap NAT untuk trafik lain bukan penghematan yang tersedia.

options.text: The interface endpoint: $30 versus $45.
options.explanation: 20 ditambah 10 sama dengan 30; NAT incremental 45. Biaya NAT tetap tidak hilang.

options.text: Both cost the same because they transfer the same number of gigabytes.
options.explanation: Biaya per GB dan biaya tetap masing-masing jalur berbeda pada model soal.

options.text: The NAT path: $10 versus $45.
options.explanation: Ini mengabaikan biaya tetap endpoint dan salah memberi tarif NAT.

question: A multi-AZ application exchanges large amounts of intermediate data between tightly coupled worker pairs. The system must still survive an AZ failure. Which optimization is worth evaluating?

options.text: Route all intra-Region traffic through a distant Region.
options.explanation: Jalur lebih jauh menambah latency dan potensi biaya.

options.text: Enable DNS health checks as a guarantee that all data-transfer charges disappear.
options.explanation: Health routing tidak menghapus model penagihan transfer.

options.text: Move every worker and durable data copy into one AZ with no recovery plan.
options.explanation: Ini mengorbankan syarat bertahan dari kegagalan AZ.

options.text: Place chatty worker pairs together where feasible while retaining redundant capacity and failover across AZs.
options.explanation: Locality mengurangi transfer rutin; desain redundansi tetap mempertahankan kebutuhan availability.

question: A global CloudFront distribution fronts an expensive image-rendering origin. Different edge locations often miss on the same cacheable image at nearly the same time. Which feature can consolidate origin requests, subject to a cost-benefit check?

options.text: Disable all caching so every viewer reaches the origin directly.
options.explanation: Ini menambah pekerjaan rendering origin.

options.text: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on an unrelated upload bucket.
options.explanation: Fitur upload tersebut tidak mengonsolidasikan request ke origin rendering.

options.text: Add a unique random query parameter to every cache key.
options.explanation: Key unik menghancurkan reuse objek yang sama.

options.text: CloudFront Origin Shield.
options.explanation: Lapisan ini dapat menyatukan miss untuk objek yang sama dan menurunkan beban origin; ada biaya tambahan.

question: An EC2 worker polls an intermittently active SQS queue several times per second. Most receives return no messages. Jobs should start promptly when messages arrive. Which change reduces unnecessary receive requests without imposing a fixed sleep before every job?

options.text: Keep short polling but increase the message retention period.
options.explanation: Retention tidak mengurangi request polling ketika queue kosong.

options.text: Enable SQS long polling with an appropriate wait time and a client HTTP timeout longer than that wait.
options.explanation: Long polling menunggu pesan saat queue kosong dan dapat kembali saat pesan tersedia, sehingga mengurangi empty receives.

options.text: Wait a fixed several minutes before every ReceiveMessage request.
options.explanation: Ini mengurangi request tetapi menambah delay tetap yang tidak diperlukan saat pekerjaan tersedia.

options.text: Keep short polling and reduce the visibility timeout of every message.
options.explanation: Visibility timeout memengaruhi pesan yang sedang diproses, bukan frekuensi receive kosong.

question: A cost review proposes caching authenticated account pages under a URL-only CloudFront key to reduce origin traffic. Pages differ by user. What is the appropriate response?

options.text: Apply a very long shared TTL because a cheaper origin always outweighs user isolation.
options.explanation: TTL panjang memperpanjang risiko konten salah dibagikan.

options.text: Reject shared caching for those responses unless isolation and cache policy correctly preserve user-specific authorization; optimize public assets separately.
options.explanation: Penghematan tidak boleh membocorkan data antar-user; cache key dan behavior harus mencerminkan variasi yang aman.

options.text: Enable gzip as the only control preventing one user from receiving another user data.
options.explanation: Kompresi bukan isolasi cache atau otorisasi.

options.text: Remove authorization headers from the origin request and assume identity is still preserved.
options.explanation: Menghilangkan konteks dapat merusak otorisasi aplikasi.

question: A temporary export is deleted after ten days and downloaded frequently during that time. A proposal selects an archive tier solely for its low storage rate. Which response best evaluates total cost and usability?

options.text: Choose the coldest tier because minimum-duration charges never apply to deleted objects.
options.explanation: Beberapa kelas memiliki minimum durasi yang dapat menimbulkan biaya walau objek dihapus lebih awal.

options.text: Count only compressed bytes and ignore frequency of reads.
options.explanation: Pola akses adalah komponen utama ekonomi workload ini.

options.text: Compare request, retrieval, minimum-duration, and access-latency terms against a frequently accessed storage class before choosing.
options.explanation: Umur singkat dan banyak download dapat menghapus keuntungan tarif storage murah serta menambah delay.

options.text: Assume every archive object is readable immediately using a normal GET without restore.
options.explanation: Sebagian kelas arsip memerlukan restore sebelum akses.
